entities.name: Balesh Pass
entities.description: Snow-covered pass high in the Karplusan Mountains on Terisiare, site of battles between Kjeldor knights and Balduvian orcs.

entities.name: Karplusan Mountains
entities.description: Mountains in which Balesh Pass lies.

entities.name: Mount Delapre
entities.description: Mountain along whose edge the pass runs.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Realm whose knights fought the Balduvian orcs.

entities.name: Balduvian orcs
entities.description: Orcs who fought the knights of Kjeldor at Balesh Pass.

entities.name: Flarg goblins
entities.description: Goblins of the Flarg used as a distraction by the Balduvians.

entities.name: Groth Jonar
entities.description: Orcish general who accepted a parley and let surviving Kjeldor knights retreat, claiming their battle standard.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Dominarian Ice Age during which the pass was fought over.

events.summary: In the first battle, Balduvian orcs are routed by a wall of pikemen and charging knights of Kjeldor.
events.quote: The first was a loss for the orcs

events.summary: In the second battle, goblins of the Flarg distract the knights so the orcs can flank and kill many of them.
events.quote: bolstered by goblins of the Flarg

events.summary: Groth Jonar accepts the parley and lets surviving Kjeldor knights retreat, taking only their battle standard.
events.quote: accepted the parley and allowed the surviving knights of Kjeldor to retreat without further harm

relations.note: Their knights fought at Balesh Pass.
relations.quote: battles between knights of Kjeldor and Balduvian orcs were fought

relations.note: The pass is high in the mountains.
relations.quote: a pass high in the Karplusan Mountains
